name: Guided Feature
author: Kandown
description: An interactive feature workflow that explores the codebase, resolves product questions, obtains architecture approval, and then implements and reviews the agreed design.
summary: Discover first, clarify intent, approve the architecture, then implement with guided review.

taskTemplates.name: Feature discovery
taskTemplates.description: Maps the request, relevant code paths, constraints, unknowns, and user decisions.

taskTemplates.name: Architecture proposal
taskTemplates.description: Presents a focused design with alternatives, risks, and an explicit approval gate.

taskTemplates.name: Implementation slice
taskTemplates.description: Implements one approved, independently verifiable feature slice.

taskTemplates.name: Feature review
taskTemplates.description: Checks the implementation, runtime behavior, and acceptance criteria after delivery.

attribution.name: Building Effective AI Agents
attribution.note: Simple, composable workflow and human checkpoint principles were adapted independently. No endorsement is implied.

attribution.name: Advanced Context Engineering for Coding Agents
attribution.note: Research, plan, implementation, and early review practices were adapted independently. No endorsement is implied.
